text:
maya: quick heads-up — need final sign-off on the company-level OKR slate for Q3. doc: https://redwood.docs/okrs/q3-draft. main ask: we have four candidate initiatives; we need to decide which one(s) we cut to guarantee the launch date.

alex: curious — which customers are driving the asks? any absolute must-haves?

maya: NordBank is pushing hard for on-prem redaction + key rotation. sales flagged that as a deal driver. autoscaling/burst improvements are nice-to-have for uptake but lower urgency.

sam: if NordBank is a near-term commit, we should prioritize compliance and E2E redaction. losing them costs >$500k ARR, so leaning toward keeping that. we can deprioritize surface-level UX polish.

joni: design note: mobile polish is high-visibility but a relatively small scope (2 designers, ~1.5 sprint). we can cut it and still ship MVP flows intact.

paul: quick numbers: dropping the experimental L2 reranker saves ~12% infra cost on our test workload, but uncertain impact on conversion. need an eval.

alex: concrete trade: keep infra hardening + NordBank private deploy work; cut mobile polish + experimental reranker. frees ~6 weeks of eng runway.

maya: that aligns with the draft. we need clear acceptance criteria before sign-off though. my suggested list: 

```
Acceptance criteria (proposal):
- Private deploy: automated VPC install + KMS integration test pass
- Redaction: end-to-end PII redaction demo (NordBank corpus) with audit logs
- SLA: p95 latency < 250ms under 70% sustained load
- Regression: core prompt eval drop < 2% after quant/opt changes
- Canary rollout: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 3 days with automated rollback on error rate rise
```

alex: add rollback policy: if error rate > +3% absolute or latency p95 degrades > +80ms, auto-fallback to hosted model variant and page oncall.

ops-bot: deploy-bot scheduled canary window: 2024-07-12T03:00:00Z -> 2024-07-15T03:00:00Z (placeholder).

maya: @sam can you confirm sales is okay with this trade (delay autoscaling, cut mobile polish) so we won't jeopardize NordBank?

sam: i'll call their CTO tomorrow. my ask to them: full redaction + KMS in 8 weeks, otherwise we negotiate price. i'll update here after the call. :thumbsup:

joni: i'll trim the launch mocks and focus on core flows. ETA: EOD Thu.

paul: i'll run the cost/regression sims and post a short rundown by Fri morning.

maya: thanks team — i'm going to update the OKR doc to reflect this cut-and-keep plan and send the exec sign-off email on Friday EOD if no objections. :white_check_mark:
